"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A dramatic change in the attitude of officials in Washington is needed, shifting from a job-killing punitive mentality to a spirit of cooperation with producers, landowners, and the public, to ensure continued support for environmental efforts by the American people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Full transparency in the development of the data and modeling that drive regulations is important.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Legislation to restore the authority of States in environmental protection is essential.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The use of agricultural best management practices among the States should be encouraged to reduce pollution.",
